name: Attacking the Tower
storyline: Set after the events of Stealing the Diamond, Henry returns home to find that his house has been destroyed and his Tunisian diamond stolen by the Tower Gang, a group of thieves second only to the Toppat Clan. Seeking revenge, Henry accepts a challenge from the Tower Gang's leader - the Towerhead, to take them down himself.
summary: Attacking the Tower is a Henry Stickmin fangame made in Adobe Animate (long live the king!), serving as a faithful, non-canon love letter to the series.
